Microsoft Struggles to Repair Worldwide Outage. Here's What You Need to Know

An outage affecting Microsoft services including Outlook, Teams, and Copilot has stretched into a second day, leaving businesses and governments around the world struggling to access email communications. As of Friday midday ET, almost 24 hours since the outage was first reported, Microsoft said it was observing "signs of sustained recovery" across its services, with email queues "approaching normal levels."
